## Data Cleaning

Rows with empty cells were removed. Strings were converted into numbers. Release decade column was added.

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
data <- read.csv("Most Streamed Spotify Songs 2024.csv")

# Remove rows with empty cells
data[data == ""] <- NA
clean_data <- data %>% drop_na(Track, Album.Name, Artist, Release.Date, ISRC, 
                               Spotify.Streams, Spotify.Playlist.Count,
                               Spotify.Popularity, YouTube.Views, YouTube.Likes,
                               TikTok.Posts,TikTok.Likes, 
                               TikTok.Views, YouTube.Playlist.Reach,
                               Explicit.Track)

# Convert strings into numbers
cols <- c("Spotify.Streams", "Spotify.Playlist.Count", "Spotify.Playlist.Reach",
          "YouTube.Views", "YouTube.Likes", "TikTok.Posts",
          "TikTok.Likes", "TikTok.Views")

clean_data[cols] <- lapply(clean_data[cols], function(x) {
  x <- gsub(",", "", x)
  as.numeric(x)
})

# Add release decade column 
clean_data$Release.Date <- as.Date(clean_data$Release.Date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")
clean_data$Release.Year <- as.numeric(format(clean_data$Release.Date, "%Y"))
clean_data$Release.Decade <- cut(
  clean_data$Release.Year,
  breaks = c(1900, 2009, 2019, 2029),
  labels = c("Pre-2010s", "2010s", "2020s")
)
```

```{r}
## Statistical Summary Table

# Summary stats for numeric variables
numeric_stats <- data.frame(
  Variable = c("Spotify Streams (Millions)", "YouTube Views (Millions)",
               "YouTube Likes (Millions)", "TikTok Posts (Thousands)",
               "TikTok Likes (Millions)", "TikTok Views (Millions)"),
  Mean   = sapply(summary_data[1:6], function(x) round(mean(x, na.rm=T), 2)),
  SD     = sapply(summary_data[1:6], function(x) round(sd(x, na.rm=T), 2)),
  Median = sapply(summary_data[1:6], function(x) round(median(x, na.rm=T), 2)),
  Min    = sapply(summary_data[1:6], function(x) round(min(x, na.rm=T), 2)),
  P25    = sapply(summary_data[1:6], function(x) round(quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm=T), 2)),
  P75    = sapply(summary_data[1:6], function(x) round(quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm=T), 2)),
  Max    = sapply(summary_data[1:6], function(x) round(max(x, na.rm=T), 2))
)

# Summary stats for Release Decade
decade_counts <- as.data.frame(table(summary_data$Release.Decade))
decade_rows <- data.frame(
  Variable = paste0("Release Decade: ", decade_counts$Var1),
  Mean   = paste0(round(decade_counts$Freq / nrow(summary_data) * 100, 1), "%"),
  SD     = "",
  Median = "",
  Min    = "",
  P25    = "",
  P75    = "",
  Max    = ""
)

# Combine
full_table <- rbind(numeric_stats, decade_rows)

full_table %>%
  kable("html", row.names = FALSE,
        col.names = c("Variable", "Mean", "Std. Dev.", "Median", "Min", "Pctl. 25", "Pctl. 75", "Max")) %>%
  kable_styling(font_size = 13, full_width = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, extra_css = "border-top: 2px solid black; border-bottom: 2px solid black; font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif;") %>%
  row_spec(nrow(full_table), extra_css = "border-bottom: 2px solid black;") %>%
  column_spec(1:8, extra_css = "font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; padding: 6px 10px;") %>%
  save_kable("summary_table.html")
```
